name: thegram-cloud
description: Thegram memory for cloud agents such as ChatGPT dots: the desktop app's gram_* tools over https://vault.thegram.one/mcp, signed in with your Thegram account. No Mac or desktop app needs to run.

interface.shortDescription: Project memory in your Thegram vaults and Google Drive
interface.longDescription: Read, search and record decisions, tasks, events and history in .gram documents stored in Thegram Cloud or your Google Drive, the same documents the Thegram app shows.
defaultPrompt: Use Thegram to show what changed in my project memory this week.
Use Thegram to record this decision in my project memory.
